description: IAM Unified Access Policy governing Agent Gateway egress to registered MCP servers and internal banking tools.

bindings.description: Allows Agent Gateway core service to proxy and route governed agent traffic.
Allows Agent Gateway to interact with Vertex AI Agent Runtime and Gemini models.
Allows Agent Gateway to invoke Model Armor security templates for payload inspection.
Allows Agent Gateway to forward validated MCP tool invocations to Cloud Run.
Enforces that callers through Agent Gateway have explicit egress authorization on Agent Registry endpoints.
